Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a state public utility tax exemption for the transportation of grain by motor vehicle.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a state public utility tax exemptionfor the transportation of grain by motor vehicle; adding a new sectionto chapter 82.16 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.16 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This chapter does not apply to amounts received from thetransportation of grain by a motorpropelled vehicle. For the purposesof this section, "grain" means all cereal crops except for corn.
